newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Special Met shares up on brighter outlook.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Special Met shares up on brighter outlook.

text.p: Shares of Sumitomo Special Metals Co Ltd, a manufacturer of permanent magnets for electronics, jumped on Friday morning, helped by the announcement late on Thursday that the firm had revised its earnings forecast upward, traders said.
At 0137 GMT, the share price was up 90 yen at 1,860. Its trading volume was 341,000 shares.
Sumitomo Special Metals said on Thursday that its parent current forecast for the six months to September 30, 1997 was revised to two billion yen, up from its previous forecast of 1.40 billion yen.
